sloka: पुष्पध्वजवती: पूर्णा: शुक्लस्यान्नस्य चाभित: ।ददृशुर्विस्मितास्तत्र नरा लौही: सहस्रश: ॥ २.९१.६७॥
transliteration: puṣpadhvajavatī: pūrṇā: śuklasyānnasya cābhita: ।dadṛśurvismitāstatra narā lauhī: sahasraśa: ॥ 2.91.67॥

translations.english: In that army there was none who could be seen without wearing garments of sparkling white, who was hungry or dirty or with decayed hair.
